## DISCORD - Student Recap (M6)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/discord/student-recap

**Input:**
```json
{
  "guild_id": "string",
  "user_id": "string",
  "thread_id": "string",
  "period": "week" | "month" | "all",
  "include_help_requests": true
}
```

**Flow:**
1. Validate input (guild_id, user_id required)
2. Fetch conversation history from Redis
3. Optionally fetch help requests from backend
4. Generate structured recap via LLM (Anthropic)

**Output:** Structured recap with stats and _trace

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["recap", "stats"],
  "domain": "education"
}
```
